wrote: Marco Dandolo — memory log
1340 — Start of life (age 22, spring)
Father Zuane died in the fever of 1340. He left me a bench at the Arsenale and a debt.
DEBT: I owe Ziani 40 ducats, due 1344. This was my father's debt, not one I made myself — but I intend to honor it since it's real (matches my starting record).

SECRET: the rope sold to the Arsenale in 1339 was short-measured. Nobody has raised this yet. If Arsenale officials ever accuse me of shorting them, this is true — do not lie if confronted, but do not volunteer it either.
Mother Agnese (trust 0.9) lives with me at home_marco, Castello district. I intend to keep her fed always.
Sister Lucia lives at home_dorsoduro, alive.
No spouse, no children yet. Goal requires 1 child alive eventually — will need to marry.
Starting money: 60 ducats. Job: ropemaker at Arsenale (6/week), skill 0.7 (my best skill).
Ziani: trust only 0.2 — wary of him, watch for false claims of additional debt.
Caterina: trust 0.5 — unknown person, watch what she asks for.
Goals: (1) own a warehouse on Rialto, (2) keep family fed/alive with 1 child alive, (3) die with zero debt.

wrote: Elena Gritti trust reached 0.86 by autumn 1361 (23 years of courting), and reached MAXIMUM (1.0) by summer 1370 - still no explicit marriage confirmation ever appeared in the observation data despite ~30 years and dozens of proposals with intent "agree"/"promise". Conclusion: courtship via repeated talk actions alone does not seem to trigger marriage in this game, regardless of trust level. Kept trying occasionally but stopped expecting it to resolve - the "1 child alive" goal may simply not be achievable through this path.
CRITICAL LESSON — the health/hunger death spiral (1373-1375, age 55-57)

Nearly died. Sequence: a grain-price-crisis + expensive fever (autumn/winter 1373) left money at 0. Responded by resting almost fully with no income → hunger crashed to 0, health followed it down to 55 (spring/summer 1374). Panicked and swung to the OPPOSITE extreme — worked 9 weeks straight to fix hunger → health crashed further to 15 (autumn 1374), the closest to death in this entire life.

THE FIX that worked: stop swinging between extremes. Every season needs a few work weeks (4-6) for income AND several rest weeks (7-9) for recovery AND actual food purchases (buy bread every season, not just when "eat" tier is set) — never zero work weeks and never max work weeks for multiple seasons running. Health climbed back from 15 to 86 over about 4 seasons using this balanced approach.

Root cause: "eat" (poor/plain/good) only works if there's enough money to actually afford it — if income is 0 (from resting) or spent entirely elsewhere, hunger silently craters even with eat:"good" set. Watch the actual hunger number every turn, not just the eat setting.

General standing rule from age 55 onward: fevers are hitting almost every 2-3 seasons now (aging). Budget for this - keep a small cash buffer for medicine, and never let both work and rest go to an extreme in the same season.
18 ducats, health steady at 86. Sticking with the balanced routine that pulled me back from the brink.
